streams.pump_role: HPLC pump delivering pre-mixed liquid reagents
streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Pre-mixed liquid phase containing all liquid reagents. Flow rate derived from Engineering Design Calculations Step 3 (Q_total = 0.500 mL/min).

streams.pump_role: Mass Flow Controller (MFC) for CO gas
streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Gaseous reagent introduced under pressure. Flow rate derived from Engineering Design Calculations Step 9 (CO MFC = 3.36 sccm).

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Pre-mix Pd catalyst, aryl halide, and base in solvent to ensure catalyst activation before introducing CO gas. Engineering Design Calculations Step 6 indicates Da = 2.77 > 1, suggesting mixing may limit conversion; a static mixer insert is recommended to enhance gas-liquid mass transfer.
pre_reactor_steps: Deoxygenate liquid feed via sparging with CO or inert gas (N2/Ar) prior to pumping to prevent Pd oxidation and CO oxidation to CO2, as per Chemistry Plan deoxygenation_required: true.
post_reactor_steps: Quench reaction mixture with Aqueous Acid or Base depending on workup to deactivate catalyst and neutralize excess base, as per Chemistry Plan quench_required: true.
Vent CO gas through a scrubber or incineration system due to toxicity.
chemistry_notes: Pd-catalyzed carbonylation of aryl halide. High pressure (15 bar) required for CO solubility. Gas-liquid mass transfer is critical (Da=2.77). Static mixer recommended. Deoxygenation essential. No photochemistry involved.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Engineering Design Calculations Step 2: tau = 18.0 min. Based on kinetic class IF=10x reduction from batch 3h.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system. Using inlet/STP apparent residence time as primary metric for reactor sizing V = t_inlet * (Q_liquid + Q_gas_STP).
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (100 C) as per Chemistry Plan and Engineering Design Calculations Step 1.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Engineering Design Calculations Step 8: BPR REQUIRED. Set to 15 bar to match batch pressure and ensure CO solubility (Henry's law).
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA preferred for thermal stability at 100 C and chemical resistance. FEP also acceptable but PFA has higher temp rating.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.1 M as per Batch Input and Chemistry Plan stream_logic.
